purpose: Separate historical observability from underlying pre-vote activity. Preserve the strict public-availability lane for historical as-of replay while adding a retrospective activity-clock lane for signal learning using the same already-frozen five candidate-finance features.

hypothesis.statement: Underlying candidate-finance activity that occurred before a vote may contain retrospective predictive signal even when the exact row/value was not yet publicly observable at the historical forecast cutoff.

publicAvailability.eligibility: asOfEligible=true AND published_at IS NOT NULL AND transactionDateIsAvailability=false
publicAvailability.use: strict historical as-of replay and claims about what a model could have known at the time

underlyingActivity.use: retrospective signal learning and hypothesis generation only

annualReportingPeriod.rule: When an evidence row is an annual aggregate rather than a point event, the reporting-period end date may serve as a conservative underlying-activity date for later votes only.
annualReportingPeriod.example: A 2022 annual lobbying total may be activity-clock eligible for votes after 2022-12-31 even if its exact public-availability date is later or unproven.
